Name: I can't get no sleep
Author: BrochersModsProductions
Description:
[heading]Description
[line]
[/heading]
Stay awake past 2 AM and keep playing until 6 AM! ICGNS starts a new day and saves your progress at dawn.
By default, shipping-bin items sell when you sleep or pass out from exhaustion. Turn on dawn shipping if you want the usual sales screen and sale at 6 AM after an all-nighter.

[heading]Download Instructions
[line]
[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download [b]I Can't Get No Sleep[/b] from the [b]Files[/b] tab or the [url=https://github.com/superbroche-s-organisation/I-Can-t-Get-No-Sleep/releases/tag/v2.0.0]GitHub release[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]I Can't Get No Sleep [/b]folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]When updating, close the game first and keep your existing "config.json".

[heading]Main Features
[line]
[/heading]
[list]
[*]Play through the night with an automatic save at 6 AM, including when you are in the Mines, Skull Cavern or Volcano Dungeon.[/*]
[*]Build up fatigue after an all-nighter. The first level starts at 6 PM after your first awake dawn and reduces maximum energy. Later levels also slow movement. Sleep to recover.[/*]
[*]See fatigue beside health and energy from level 1 and hover to check the time until the next level. Fatigue, the gauge and the countdown each have a separate toggle, all on by default.[/*]
[*]Watch an optional sunrise from 4 AM to 6 AM and hear the music for your current location when the new day starts.[/*]
[*]Keep unsold items through all-nighters and reloads, or enable the normal shipping screen and sale at dawn.[/*]
[/list]

With shared money, shipping requires every online player to sleep or pass out. With separate wallets, each player’s sales depend on their own sleep.

[heading]Requirements
[line]
[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15 (build 24356)[/b] on [b]64-bit Windows[/b].[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional for in-game settings.[/*]
[*]For multiplayer, install the same version on the host and every player. Version 2.0 was verified in solo play. Live multiplayer testing is pending.[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/superbroche-s-organisation/I-Can-t-Get-No-Sleep/tree/main][b]Public GitHub and Issue Tracker[/b][/url]
